zh-Hans.name: Nvidia VFX VSR
zh-Hans.summary: AI 视频增强，可放大、降噪或去模糊。
zh-Hans.details:
按素材选择常规、高码率或流媒体放大；降噪和去模糊保持输入尺寸。各分类分别记住质量档位与缩放设置。档位提高不保证更适合素材，请比较纹理、噪声与开销。

需要受支持的 NVIDIA 渲染 GPU、驱动及匹配的 VFX 运行库。流媒体仅提供中／极高档，要求 Ampere 及更新架构。HDR 使用 SDR 兼容转换，可能改变高光与颜色。

修改分类需重新启动缩放；质量档位可实时切换，加载模型时可能短暂停顿。

en-US.name: Nvidia VFX VSR
en-US.summary: AI video enhancement with upscaling, denoising, or deblurring.
en-US.details:
Choose Standard, High bitrate, or Streaming for upscaling; Denoise and Deblur keep the input size. Each category remembers its quality and scaling settings. Higher quality levels are not always a better fit; compare texture, noise, and cost.

Requires a supported NVIDIA rendering GPU, driver, and matching VFX runtime. Streaming offers only Medium/Ultra and requires Ampere or later. HDR uses an SDR compatibility conversion that can change highlights and colors.

Category changes require restarting scaling. Quality levels can change live; loading a model may briefly pause processing.

zh-Hans.name: Nvidia VFX TrueHDR
zh-Hans.summary: 用 AI 将 SDR 扩展为 HDR，可减轻色带。
zh-Hans.details:
保持输入尺寸，用 AI 重新塑造亮度与颜色；不代表恢复原始 HDR。放在 SDR 效果段之后，HDR 源需先添加 HDR → SDR。需要受支持的 NVIDIA 渲染 GPU、驱动和匹配的 VFX TrueHDR 运行库，输出屏幕需开启 Windows HDR。

按显示器能力设置峰值亮度，再比较对比度、饱和度和中间灰；去色带默认开启。五项参数均可实时调整。搭配 VFX VFG 时，真实帧和生成帧都会经过 TrueHDR。

en-US.name: Nvidia VFX TrueHDR
en-US.summary: AI expansion from SDR to HDR, with optional debanding.
en-US.details:
Keeps the input size and uses AI to reshape brightness and color; it does not recover original HDR. Place it after SDR image effects, adding HDR → SDR first for an HDR source. Requires a supported NVIDIA rendering GPU, driver, matching VFX TrueHDR runtime, and Windows HDR enabled on the output display.

Set peak brightness to suit the display, then compare contrast, saturation, and middle gray. Debanding is enabled by default. All five parameters update live. With VFX VFG, both real and generated frames pass through TrueHDR.

zh-Hans.name: Nvidia VFX Upscale
zh-Hans.summary: 轻量视频放大，支持固定倍率和自动适配。
zh-Hans.details:
用于视频放大，可调节输出锐度；需要 AI 降噪或去模糊时可比较 VFX VSR。需要受支持的 NVIDIA 渲染 GPU、驱动及匹配的 VFX Upscale 运行库。HDR 使用 SDR 兼容转换，可能改变高光与颜色。

固定倍率为 4/3×、1.5×、2×、3×、4×，宽高使用相同倍率，输出必须为整数尺寸。自动模式选择能覆盖目标的最低合法倍率，再用 Bicubic 等比适配；目标超过 4× 时继续放大。尺寸超过设备限制会拒绝启动。运行面板可查看原生尺寸和适配结果。

锐度可实时调整，过高可能产生光晕；倍率或目标尺寸修改需重新启动缩放。

en-US.name: Nvidia VFX Upscale
en-US.summary: Lightweight video upscaling with fixed ratios or automatic target fitting.
en-US.details:
Upscales video with adjustable sharpness. Compare VFX VSR when AI denoising or deblurring is needed. Requires a supported NVIDIA rendering GPU, driver, and matching VFX Upscale runtime. HDR uses an SDR compatibility conversion that can change highlights and colors.

Fixed ratios are 4/3x, 1.5x, 2x, 3x, and 4x, equal on both axes with integer output dimensions. Auto mode selects the lowest legal ratio covering the target, then fits it proportionally with Bicubic; targets beyond 4x need further upscaling. Dimensions exceeding device limits are rejected. The running panel shows native and fitted sizes.

Sharpness updates live; excessive sharpening can cause halos. Ratio or target-size changes require restarting scaling.

zh-Hans.name: Nvidia VFX VFG
zh-Hans.summary: SDR 视频 2×～8× 补帧，可搭配 TrueHDR。
zh-Hans.details:
在连续视频帧之间生成中间帧，保持输入尺寸。Windows x64 需要 Ada／Blackwell 架构的 NVIDIA 渲染 GPU、驱动和匹配的 VFX VFG 运行库。仅处理 SDR；HDR 源需先显式添加 HDR → SDR。同一效果组只使用一个补帧器。

图像效果先处理，再补帧；拖动 VFG 条目不会改变处理阶段。使用 TrueHDR 时，首个 TrueHDR 及其后效果会处理每张真实／生成帧。这一段仅支持 TrueHDR、Bicubic、Bilinear、CAS 和 FSR RCAS；其他效果需移到 TrueHDR 前或移除。

性能／均衡模型可实时切换；倍率及自动场切检测修改需重新启动缩放。默认 2×、均衡，自动场切检测开启。检查快速运动、遮挡与文字伪影；高倍率增加处理开销，实际帧率受处理能力和显示节奏限制。

基础帧率、重复检测和空闲持续重绘使用“帧率与刷新”设置。空闲重绘复用缓存，不额外补帧；补帧不提高游戏逻辑帧率，也不保证降低输入延迟。

en-US.name: Nvidia VFX VFG
en-US.summary: SDR video frame generation at 2x–8x, with optional TrueHDR.
en-US.details:
Generates intermediate video frames without resizing. Windows x64 requires an NVIDIA Ada/Blackwell rendering GPU, driver, and matching VFX VFG runtime. Processing is SDR only; add HDR → SDR explicitly for HDR sources. Use one frame generator per group.

Image effects run before interpolation, regardless of the VFG entry position. When TrueHDR is present, the first TrueHDR and all following effects process every real/generated frame. This section supports only TrueHDR, Bicubic, Bilinear, CAS, and FSR RCAS; move other effects before TrueHDR or remove them.

Performance/Balanced models can switch live. Multiplier and automatic shot detection changes require restarting scaling. Defaults are 2x, Balanced, and automatic shot detection enabled. Check fast motion, occlusion, and text artifacts. Higher multipliers add cost; processing capacity and display pacing limit actual FPS.

Base FPS, duplicate detection, and idle redraw use Frame rate and refresh settings. Idle redraw reuses cached output without interpolation. Generation does not raise game simulation FPS or guarantee lower input latency.
